pages.text: Role: endgame melee weapon. Core loop: opener slash -> stack hits -> execute finish.
Craft path: Singularity line drops and realm-grade materials.
$(l)Active: Annihilation Slash$(/l)$(br2)Right click to release a forward wave for burst engage and spacing control.
$(l)Passive: Mark Loop$(/l)$(br2)Basic hits stack marks. At max stacks, trigger a heavy execute pulse around the target.
$(l)Tips$(/l)$(br2)$(li)Open with right click$(li)Keep close for stack uptime$(li)Use execute timing to snowball sustain
